engineeringSkip.reason: The term 'quantum 3D printing' is a buzzword mash-up with no established research field or coherent technical basis in quantum physics.

factCheck.reason: Quantum effects play no role in how a material is extruded, cured or bonded, so nothing in quantum physics improves print quality or durability — 'quantum 3D printing' is two unrelated words bolted together, not a real manufacturing method.
